request.style: English, children's song, cheerful female lead vocal with kids choir, ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, bright and playful, sing-along, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
For forty days the giant shouted
Morning and evening, loud and tall
All the soldiers shook and trembled
No one dared to fight at all
Then a shepherd boy came running
Bringing bread for brothers three
Said why is everybody hiding
God is bigger, come and see

[Chorus]
Five smooth stones from the stream
A sling and a shepherd's bag
Not a sword and not a spear
But a heart that trusts in the LORD
One, two, three, four, five
Little David, brave and wise

[Verse]
King Saul gave him his heavy armor
Bronze helmet shining on his head
David tried to walk and wobbled
I'm not used to these, he said
So he took his staff and pebbles
Ran to meet the giant there
I come in the name of the LORD of hosts
The God of Israel everywhere

[Chorus]
Five smooth stones from the stream
A sling and a shepherd's bag
Not a sword and not a spear
But a heart that trusts in the LORD
One, two, three, four, five
Little David, brave and wise

[Bridge]
Swing it round and let it go
Down the giant fell, oh whoa
The LORD does not save with sword or spear
When you are small, God is near

[Outro]
One, two, three, four, five
Little David, brave and wise
